note: Worker output contract. The scorer (~/dynamics_atlas_eval/eval/score.py) enforces it. Change only by asking Alex/Claude; the improver may not edit this file.

files_per_case.rows.jsonl: one JSON object per (paper, experiment, condition) evidence row
files_per_case.summary.md: one page (<= 600 words) for Gina, plain scientific English, inline row ids like [r3]

row_fields.row_id: r1, r2, ... unique within the case
row_fields.entry_id: RelaxDB entry id from the input card
row_fields.doi: lowercase DOI, or empty if none (then pmid or url in title field)
row_fields.title: paper title
row_fields.source_file: path relative to sources_cache/ of the TEXT derivative (.txt/.md/.xml/.html) the anchor comes from
row_fields.experiment: specific measurement, e.g. 15N CPMG at 600/800 MHz
row_fields.buffer: as reported; name phosphate explicitly when present
row_fields.other_conditions: field strengths, pressure, deuteration, labels/tags, etc.
row_fields.residues_author: residues in the paper's numbering WITH one-letter type, e.g. K73, Y106, A30-K38
row_fields.residues_entry: same residues as positions in the RelaxDB entry sequence (same order), e.g. 73, 106, 30-38; empty if mapping unknown
row_fields.dynamics_type: e.g. us-ms exchange, ps-ns flexibility, domain closure, ligand-coupled
row_fields.timescale: value + unit + parameter name (kex, tau_ex, k_AB, ...) + model, exactly as reported
row_fields.population: value + which state, exactly as reported
row_fields.alt_state_structure: PDB id or structural description of an alternate state and how it was obtained
row_fields.author_claim: the authors' conclusion in one sentence
row_fields.artefact_note: required when stance is artefact_suspected or a confound applies (phosphate buffer with a phosphate/nucleotide/nucleic-acid binder, paramagnetic/lanthanide tag motion, EDTA vs Mg, phospho-mimic vs phosphorylation, deuteration/temperature differences)
row_fields.anchor: verbatim quote of >= 8 words copied from source_file that supports the row
row_fields.locator: Figure/Table/page/section where the anchor and numbers are

rules: Every number in timescale/population/temperature/ph must appear in source_file.
abstract_only rows carry no numbers in timescale/population.
Every single residue in residues_author carries its one-letter type; residues_entry must place that type at that position of the entry sequence.
coverage.json answers all 11 named classes with found or searched_not_found (with at least one query and hit count); never leave a class unsearched.
summary.md cites only existing row ids and uses no internal jargon (claim ceiling, source-bounded, packet, replay, gold).
Homolog evidence stays in homolog rows; never attach a homolog's number to the target.
